findings.summary:
Loading state uses a bespoke inline `

جارٍ التحميل…

` instead of the shared LoadingScreen primitive used across the app.
findings.fix:
Import LoadingScreen and render `if(q.isLoading)return ;` (or render it in place of the `

` fallback) for a branded, consistent loading experience.

findings.summary: The Panel empty-state fallback (`{children||<EmptyState.../>}`) never renders because `children` is a non-empty array of `.map()` results and an empty array is truthy in React, so panels with no data show a blank body instead of the intended EmptyState.
findings.fix: Compute whether the panel has any rows and gate on that, e.g. accept a boolean `isEmpty` prop (or check `React.Children.count`/array length before passing) and render `{isEmpty ? <EmptyState .../> : children}` so genuinely empty panels show the empty message.

findings.summary: The EmptyState (a full `.card` with min-h-56) is rendered inside a Panel that is itself a `.card` with a `divide-y` body, producing a nested card-in-card that breaks the panel's visual rhythm.
findings.fix: Render a lightweight inline empty message inside the panel body (e.g. a centered `p-8 text-center text-[var(--text-muted)]` block) rather than the full EmptyState card, reserving EmptyState for page-level emptiness.

findings.summary: The five MetricCards use only label/value/icon and omit the `hint` prop, leaving cards without the supporting context line the MetricCard component supports and other pages provide.
findings.fix: Pass a short `hint` to each MetricCard (e.g. `hint="مغلقة/مفتوحة"` for risks, `hint="هذا العام"` for objectives) to match the fuller MetricCard usage elsewhere; purely optional if the design intentionally omits hints.
